channel.title: Regency House Assisted Living: Family Resources
channel.description: Guides for families considering assisted living and respite care in Hixson, Tennessee.

item.title: Assisted Living, Nursing Home or Home Care: Which Fits?
item.description: Most families in Hixson and Chattanooga arrive at this question the same way.

item.title: All-Inclusive or Levels of Care? How to Compare Assisted Living Costs
item.description: Call three assisted living communities in the Chattanooga area and ask the same question, "What does it cost?", and you may get three answers that cannot be laid side by side.

item.title: Respite Care in Chattanooga: A Real Break for Caregivers
item.description: If you are the one who checks on Mom every morning, fills Dad's pill organizer on Sundays and cancels your own plans when something goes wrong, you already know what caregiving costs.

item.title: Home for the Holidays: Signs a Parent Needs More Help
item.description: For many families in Hixson and around Chattanooga, Thanksgiving is the first long visit with Mom or Dad since summer.

item.title: Choosing Assisted Living in Hixson: A Family Checklist
item.description: If you are reading this late at night on your phone, you are not alone.
